# Jason Gallagher

> Growth marketing and demand generation leader in Colorado. This portfolio covers marketing results, professional experience, and tools Jason has built.

Jason has 12+ years of experience building demand generation programs, lifecycle automation, and measurement systems. The site includes marketing case studies and personal software projects.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://www.jasongallagher.co/): Marketing case studies, selected results, experience, biography, and contact links.
- [Projects](https://www.jasongallagher.co/projects): Analytics tools, AI workflows, and creative projects, including Market Data Dashboard, Beat Canvas, and 808Lab.
- [Résumé](https://www.jasongallagher.co/resume): Redirects to Jason's current résumé on Google Drive.
